problem_text: Find all integers n for which each cell of an n×n table can be filled with one of the letters I, M and O in such a way that: (1) in each row and each column, one third of the entries are I, one third are M and one third are O; and (2) in any diagonal, if the number of entries on the diagonal is a multiple of three, then one third of the entries are I, one third are M and one third are O. Note: The rows and columns of an n×n table are each labelled 1 to n in a natural order. Thus each cell corresponds to a pair of positive integers (i,j) with 1 ≤ i,j ≤ n. For n>1, the table has 4n-2 diagonals of two types. A diagonal of first type consists all cells (i,j) for which i+j is a constant, and the diagonal of second type consists all cells (i,j) for which i-j is constant.
solution_text: Necessity: Obviously 3|n. Let n=3k. Consider three types of cells: (1) all cells in rows 2,5,8,...,3k-1; (2) all cells in columns 2,5,8,...,3k-1; (3) all cells on diagonals whose length is a multiple of 3. Each type has balanced I,M,O (type 1 from row condition, type 2 from column condition, type 3 from diagonal condition). A cell at the intersection of selected rows and selected columns is counted 4 times (once in each type, and twice from two diagonal types since i≡j mod 3 and i+j≡1 mod 3 both hold), while other cells are counted exactly once. Therefore the k² intersection cells must also be balanced, forcing 3|k², hence 3|k, so 9|n. Sufficiency: For n=9, construct a 9×9 pattern using 3×3 blocks with cyclic shifts (III MMM OOO / MMM OOO III / OOO III MMM, repeated 3 times). For n=9l, tile l² copies of the 9×9 pattern. Rows/columns work by repetition. Diagonals: cell (i,j) lies on a diagonal with 3|length iff i≡j mod 3 or i+j≡1 mod 3, so diagonal segments within each 9×9 block are themselves 3|length diagonals of the 9×9 pattern, hence balanced.
solution_summary: 必要性：3|n，令n=3k，二重计数三类格子（选中行、选中列、平衡对角线），交叉处k²个格子被计4次而其余计1次，迫使交叉格子平衡故3|k即9|n。充分性：9×9显式构造+平铺到9l。
answer: n = 9k for any positive integer k

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构。有哪些约束条件？我们在寻找什么类型的答案？
rounds.expected_answer: n×n表格用I,M,O填满，满足：(1)每行每列各1/3；(2)长度为3倍数的对角线各1/3。寻找所有满足条件的正整数n。

rounds.question: 列出所有可能的方法来处理这个问题
rounds.expected_answer: 检查小case(n=3,6,9)；从行/列条件推导必要条件；利用对角线约束；尝试二重计数；构造显式填充；用平铺证明充分性

rounds.question: 从行条件能立即推出什么？然后试n=3
rounds.expected_answer: 行条件给出3|n。n=3时每行是{I,M,O}的排列（拉丁方）。两条主对角线长度均为3，都需1/3各字母。但任何3×3拉丁方中至少一条对角线是常数，故n=3不行

rounds.question: 写n=3k。考虑第2,5,8,...,3k-1行的所有格子、第2,5,8,...,3k-1列的所有格子、以及长度为3倍数的所有对角线上的格子。每个格子在这三类中总共被计算了几次？
rounds.expected_answer: 交叉处格子（既在选中行又在选中列）被计4次（行类1次+列类1次+两类对角线各1次），其余格子被计1次。三类各自平衡，故交叉处k²个格子也必须平衡

rounds.question: 从二重计数的结论，k²个交叉格子必须平衡意味着什么？
rounds.expected_answer: k²个格子各有1/3的I,M,O，故3|k²，进而3|k，因此9|n

rounds.question: 现在构造n=9的有效填充。什么模式可行？
rounds.expected_answer: 用9×9模式：3×3块循环移位，如III MMM OOO / MMM OOO III / OOO III MMM 重复3次。验证行、列、对角线均满足条件

rounds.question: 将n=9的构造推广到n=9l。为什么平铺可行？
rounds.expected_answer: 平铺l²个9×9模式。行/列由重复性满足。对角线：cell(i,j)在3|长度的对角线上当且仅当i≡j mod 3或i+j≡1 mod 3，故对角线在每个9×9块内的部分恰是该块的3|长度对角线，因此平衡
